text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right after the race...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaahhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I loooost! Urghhh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sob... Traineeer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I knew it was a stretch, but I... I wanted to win so bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon looks truly disappointed,
emotions
heightened by the amount of
effort she put in.
Nonetheless...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: まだステージは終わってないぞ
まだステージは終わってないよ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. I can't forget about the
concert. My
fans are waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go dance! And since I'm an
Umadol, I'll
do it with a smile on my
face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drying her tears, she takes her place in
the
winning concert before a packed
venue. The
performance is nothing short
of amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So this... this is the top stage!

text_block_list.name: Center Umamusume
text_block_list.text: La, la, laaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's where I really wanted to be...
There in the
center...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No, I will stand there. Next time, it's going to be me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The concert comes to a close, and Smart
Falcon
returns a little happier than when
she left.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I sang my heart out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Totally amazing!
choice_data_list: トップの景色はどうだった？

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that doesn't even scratch the
surface. I'm not
sure how to describe it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it was so bright up there! The
spotlights,
the crowd and their
glowsticks. Everything I could
see was
shining...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but wonder, what if all
those lights
were shining on me? That
must be the best feeling
ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I've decided I wanna
stand on a
big stage again.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But next time, it's gotta be the biggest
stage on
dirt!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to see that same dazzling
performance and
huge, cheering
audience... but at a dirt race!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And of course, I want to be the one in
the center!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After experiencing the winning concert
of a
Classic race, she's even more
determined to
become the top Umadol
on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I wanna try a G1 dirt race
next!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My rookie days are over. It's time to take
my next
step as an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that step... is to get up on a stage
that'll
make me known all over the
country.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run more G1 races like the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite today's disappointment, there's
no
doubting Smart Falcon's abilities on
dirt. She
surely has what it takes to
compete against the
powerful runners
the G1 races attract. In which
case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a race reserved only for classic-year
racers,
just like the Satsuki Sho, and one
I'd love to see
her win.
choice_data_list: 『ジャパンダートダービー』はどう？

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me! Really, I'm good
with
anything as long as it's a G1!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's not a lot of G1 dirt races out
there... So
I've gotta get on every stage I
can!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next stop, the Japan Dirt Derby and the
top of
the dirt world! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is decided. Japan Dirt
Derby, here
we come!
